sql_by_query.q_2a360a7bacd9e76aa652966f: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', t0.ngay_tao) AS period, COALESCE(SUM(t0.so_tien) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai IN ('SUCCESS', 'THANH_CONG', 'DA_THANH_TOAN')), 0) AS "settled_payment_amount" FROM silver.giao_dich_thanh_toan AS t0 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', t0.ngay_tao) ORDER BY period ASC LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_2dbdd66832b3477b941d9ba3: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "payment_count", COALESCE(SUM(t0.so_tien) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai IN ('SUCCESS', 'THANH_CONG', 'DA_THANH_TOAN')), 0) AS "settled_payment_amount", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT t0.trang_thai IN ('SUCCESS', 'THANH_CONG', 'DA_THANH_TOAN')) AS "unsettled_payment_count" FROM silver.giao_dich_thanh_toan AS t0 LIMIT 2

sql_by_query.q_044d8cb1496d6de5c478e80b: SELECT CASE WHEN t2.thanh_pho IN ('Hà Nội', 'Hải Phòng', 'Bắc Ninh', 'Quảng Ninh') THEN 'Miền Bắc' WHEN t2.thanh_pho IN ('Đà Nẵng', 'Nghệ An', 'Thanh Hóa', 'Thừa Thiên - Huế', 'Khánh Hòa', 'Lâm Đồng') THEN 'Miền Trung' WHEN t2.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh', 'Cần Thơ', 'Bình Dương', 'Đồng Nai', 'Bà Rịa - Vũng Tàu', 'Kiên Giang') THEN 'Miền Nam' ELSE 'Chưa phân loại' END AS "reporting_region", COUNT(*) AS "delivery_count" FROM silver.giao_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.don_hang AS t1 ON t0.ma_don_hang = t1.ma_don_hang JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t2 ON t1.co_so_ma = t2.ma_chi_nhanh GROUP BY CASE WHEN t2.thanh_pho IN ('Hà Nội', 'Hải Phòng', 'Bắc Ninh', 'Quảng Ninh') THEN 'Miền Bắc' WHEN t2.thanh_pho IN ('Đà Nẵng', 'Nghệ An', 'Thanh Hóa', 'Thừa Thiên - Huế', 'Khánh Hòa', 'Lâm Đồng') THEN 'Miền Trung' WHEN t2.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh', 'Cần Thơ', 'Bình Dương', 'Đồng Nai', 'Bà Rịa - Vũng Tàu', 'Kiên Giang') THEN 'Miền Nam' ELSE 'Chưa phân loại' END ORDER BY "reporting_region" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_1d7d7137b3d477806a170551: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_giao_hang = 'DELIVERED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "delivery_success_rate" FROM silver.giao_hang AS t0 WHERE (t0.trang_thai_giao_hang IN ('DELIVERED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')) LIMIT 2
sql_by_query.q_1d8fdaf831f93b45d6c67425: SELECT t2.thanh_pho AS "city", COUNT(*) AS "delivery_count" FROM silver.giao_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.don_hang AS t1 ON t0.ma_don_hang = t1.ma_don_hang JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t2 ON t1.co_so_ma = t2.ma_chi_nhanh GROUP BY t2.thanh_pho ORDER BY "city" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
